## Overview

Describes an element with a short text bubble on hover and keyboard focus.

- **Kind:** Directive
- **Export as:** `vantaTooltip`
- **Stability:** `candidate`

## Selector

```text
[vantaTooltip]
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vantaTooltip` | `string` |  | Yes | The tooltip text. Leave empty to disable the tooltip. |
| `vantaTooltipDelay` | `unknown` | `300` |  | Delay before the bubble opens, in milliseconds. Transform `numberAttribute`; reads as `number`. |

## Models

Two-way bindings: each model is an input and emits the matching change output.

| Model | Type | Default | Required | Change output | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vantaTooltipOpen` | `boolean` | `false` |  | `vantaTooltipOpenChange` | Whether the bubble is currently shown. Two-way bindable: `[(vantaTooltipOpen)]`. |
